name: Tanados UI
description: Tanados UI rebrands Jellyfin Web automatically with the Tanados logo/colors and adds the enhanced MonWUI/JMSFusion experience layer.
overview: Tanados-branded Jellyfin Web UI upgrade with automatic logo replacement, purple/gold theme accents, cinematic sliders, enhanced details, playback, profiles, watchlist, and settings.

versions.changelog:
v2.9.0.6

Hotfixes:
- Fixed the invisible side menu regression by preserving Jellyfin's native fixed nav-drawer positioning instead of overriding `.mainDrawer` with `position: relative`
- Kept the safer native drawer markup styling and realistic drawer smoke coverage from the previous hotfix so sidebar buttons and labels stay visible over the glass shell
- Kept the series and season audio flag fallback plus auth-aware badge cache refresh logic

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded

v2.9.0.5

Hotfixes:
- Fixed the Tanados sidebar shell again by styling native Jellyfin drawer markup safely, keeping the real drawer content above the glass overlay, and restoring visible sidebar buttons and labels
- Fixed audio language flags for series and seasons by resolving a representative episode when the parent item itself has no audio streams
- Cleared audio badge caches on auth and userdata changes so flags recover after login or token churn instead of getting stuck empty
- Updated browser smoke coverage to use a more realistic Jellyfin drawer fixture and validate series audio badge fallback alongside the existing branding, runtime shell, upcoming, and recent-row checks

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded

v2.9.0.4

Hotfixes:
- Fixed Sonarr and Radarr upcoming calendar posters so local Arr poster paths are proxied correctly and remote poster URLs fall back cleanly when needed
- Fixed the missing Tanados sidebar regression by narrowing the glass-shell drawer styling to real navigation items instead of all links and buttons inside the drawer
- Fixed audio language flags on cards and native details pages by reading media streams from both item payloads and media sources, retrying after auth warmup, and avoiding stale null caches
- Updated browser smoke coverage to validate the current audio badge item shape alongside branding, runtime shell, upcoming, and recent-row checks

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded

v2.9.0.3

Polish and fixes:
- Reworked the Tanados shell with a glass-style header and sidebar, upgraded drawer button styling, improved top navigation icons, and corrected sidebar logo branding
- Added admin toggles for showing native Jellyfin home tabs and the Watchlist shortcut in the top navigation
- Fixed settings scrolling, expanded the settings shell for desktop/mobile/TV layouts, and kept direct branding asset upload for header, login, favicon, and login background images
- Added Sonarr and Radarr connection test buttons, improved upcoming release navigation injection, and kept older manifest versions instead of overwriting them
- Fixed notification hover flicker, improved audio language badge injection, and restored hover trailer and trailer action reliability
- Expanded browser smoke coverage for branding injection, runtime shell toggles, upcoming navigation, recent rows, and audio badges

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded

v2.9.0.2

Hotfixes:
- Fixed the Tanados settings shell so long sections scroll correctly again, with a larger modal layout that behaves better on desktop, mobile, and TV-class browsers
- Added admin branding asset upload support for header logo, login logo, favicon, and login background without hand-editing plugin files
- Added browser smoke coverage for recent movie row injection alongside the existing login/settings/upcoming checks

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded
